source: Hand-written with Ahsan, 2026-10-29, from the projects list on https://www.byahsan.com (src/pages/index.astro and src/data/projects/*.json in byahsan-live). The chapters around the n-of-1 chapter, in page order: the lab, the bedside, next. The tools sentence follows the delphi description on byahsan.com; the patent sentence is his wording, word for word; the WakeLight facts are as he states them. The lab sketch is redrawn from byahsan-live/public/project-media/delphi-sketch.svg.

steps.label: In the lab
steps.line: A cancer diagnostics lab, running itself
text: I wrote the tools that take in requisitions, run results into the lab's system and print specimen labels, on the lab's own machines.
I'm also building an AI that scores breast cancer slides after chemo. Provisional patent filed 2026, in collaboration with MD Anderson Cancer Center.

steps.label: At the bedside
text: It syncs to my phone automatically and costs under $20 to make. I'm adding organic, cartoon-like motion so it feels like part of the room.
My Philips wake-up light gave a few hundred lux, and on paper the fold-out version reaches 10,000 lux at about 30 W.

steps.label: Next
text: I plan to have the lamp wake me in light sleep, using the signal from the strap. I also plan to join the raw strap signal, second by second, with the daily rows.
